text:
sre-alert-bot: Alert INC-23511 triggered: embed-store write error surge in apac-sg1, elevated 504/429 for /v1/embeddings/write.
jason_sre: Noted, seeing write QPS spike and retry amplification from dedupe-worker. Root candidate: new dedupe indexer spawned global fanout.
maya_support: CS: 4 customers flagged in last 10m, two on paid plans. Posting interim status now: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-23511
lexi_prod: Mitigation plan: 1) pause dedupe indexer 2) enable soft-queueing for bulk writes 3) route high-priority tenants to apac-fallback. Pausing indexer now.
jason_sre: Paused indexer. write QPS dropped 58% in 2m; 504 rate down but still some retries. Applying temporary write-throttle (writes/sec=200 per shard).
maya_support: CS update posted. Offering affected customers temporary quota bump on fallback path.
deploy-bot: Rolling change: set dedupe-indexer.enabled=false -> canary complete.
lexi_prod: Added circuit-breaker on embed-store client: if write errors >5% for 1m, fail fast to upstream fallback. Pushing change.
jason_sre: Observability note: adding a small dashboard tile for dedupe fanout count and retry amplification. Will correlate with embed-store latency.
maya_support: ETA to full recovery estimate 40-60m while backlog drains. Customers asked to open support ticket for urgent needs.
lexi_prod: Current status: partial mitigation in place, customer impact reduced to <0.5% of requests. Backlog draining. Postmortem owner: jason_sre. Action items: (jason) root cause RCA, (lexi) add pre-deploy load gate for indexer jobs, (maya) customer follow-ups.
sre-alert-bot: INC-23511 status -> Mitigated (reduced customer impact) at 2351109930. Monitoring for full recovery.
jason_sre: Final note: will cross-check deployment policies to prevent unbounded fanout jobs from auto-scaling without load simulation. Link to runbook: https://playbooks.redwood.ai/embed-write-failure
